pro_course_detail.description:
(This is not a conversation class, though some converation will be used in diagnostics and practice modeling. This is an Accent Reduction and pronunciation correction class, with the goal of approaching a Neutral American Accent (also called the 'Midwestern Accent'). The first sessions are dedicated to an extensive phonemic diagnostic based on students' existing natural speech, minimal pair tests, sample texts and other assessments. 

** IMPORTANT:  Please let me know before our first session what your native language is, i.e., the language you grew up speaking, even if it's not your current dominant language **

All students booking sessions with me get to benefit from my 30+ year background in broadcast and voiceover training, and my neutral Midwest [Ohio, USA] accent.

Special attention is placed on diagnosing and remedying phonetic distortion and inaccuracies which may stem from the learner's native language pronunciation and intonation patterns, previous poor training, and so forth.  All learners in my Accent Reduction sessions have different needs, depending on particular pronunciation issues, so the first session is spent diagnosing pronunciation issues, with exercises provided for home-study and practice. 

Accent reduction sessions are focused and intense, so I would suggest booking a 30 or 45 minute accent reduction/pronunciation session, followed by a more 'relaxing' one hour General Conversation or Public Speaking Session as an ideal combo.

pro_course_detail.description:
Learn English by taking a one-on-one course in Philosophy with a university professor. Let's talk and read about the big questions together: 

What is philosophy, and what does it mean to love wisdom?
What is truth and how can we distinguish truth from falsity in a "post-truth" world? 
What is art and how can we understand its place in a world so dominated by scientific thinking? 
How can we understand our roles as individuals within a larger community?
How can we determine if something is good or evil? 
What or who is God, and why do people believe in his existence, or not? 
What is phenomenology? 

These are just a few of the questions past students have been interested in. Together, we can plan a reading list and set of questions that meet your interests and needs.

(1) Learn to slowly and carefully read philosophical texts that discuss these issues. through how to improve critical thinking through particular texts. We will begin with Platonic dialogues. 
(2) Work through a textbook of Informal Logic, which will train you to think more clearly by training you to recognize and eliminate common patterns of errors, or logical fallacies. We will use Damer's "Attacking Faulty Reasoning" (6th or 7th edition).

And how has it so shaped our popular imagination? This course will give you a mini-version of what we call in English a "great-books" course: an introduction to classic texts that have shaped the history and culture of the anglophone world, in America and beyond. 

*READING*: Each session will feature a selection of works from a variety of genres and from across different periods, to improve your range of literary comprehension and to give you new angles to think from - from literature to poetry to political philosophy.*

*WRITING*: Each session will include an assignment of a short response paragraph to the readings to work on your writing skills.

*SPEAKING*: Each session, come with questions or reflections, and we can work out these themes together, as you expand your English and learn to think about big ideas!

If you want to build confidence in speaking English, I'd love to help. I am a skilled pronunciation coach, an engaging conversation partner, and an experienced guide for professionals preparing for interviews and presentations.

Every lesson includes thoughtful conversation, pronunciation support, and vocabulary building. My background is in linguistics, life coaching, and international community work. I have also raised three amazing multilingual humans. I am patient and attentive, and I build strong relationships with students to support their English goals.

Note: I do not teach beginners or children under 15.
teacher_info.about_teacher:
Whether we are having a conversation or working on pronunciation, every lesson is focused and supportive. I offer clear corrections while keeping lessons engaging and fun. My approach adapts to your needs.

Since 2021, I have worked with hundreds of students on two platforms. This experience has helped me develop effective methods and materials for pronunciation training and conversation-based learning.

I have lived, worked, or traveled in many countries. I enjoy meeting people from different backgrounds and learning about their experiences. Whatever your English goals, I look forward to working with you.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
I offer three courses to help you improve your English:  

1) Great Conversations – Practice real discussions to improve fluency, expression, and vocabulary. I correct pronunciation as needed.  

2) Master the American Accent – Systematic training in all 50 American English sounds. Focus on mouth positioning, rhythm, and stress. Lessons are 70% pronunciation and 30% conversation.  

3) Communicate with Confidence – Prepare for interviews, presentations, or IELTS. Refine your answers, organize ideas, and speak clearly.  

Book a trial lesson today, and let’s find the right course for you!

pro_course_detail.title: Have GREAT conversations in English!
pro_course_detail.description:
Want to speak more naturally and confidently in English? This course is for those who want to practice real, engaging conversations on a wide variety of topics.

I am a great conversationalist with a lot of unusual life experience.  My experiences in community level development and training as a life coach have taught me how to ask insightful questions, listen deeply, and help you express yourself with comfort and clarity. 

Some of my favorite conversation topics include:

- World affairs (social, political, and economic)
- Global and local cultures
- Parenting and family life
- International living
- Nature and its impact on society
- International development aid
- Music, food, and personal interests

Many students find our conversations useful not only for English practice but also for navigating life changes, such as considering career shifts or adjusting to life in a new country.

Though I specialize in pronunciation coaching, this course focuses on conversation practice. I will gently correct major pronunciation issues as they arise but will not provide intensive pronunciation training in these lessons.

If you're looking for friendly, thoughtful conversation practice with a supportive and experienced teacher, I’d love to chat with you!

pro_course_detail.title: Master the American Accent: Speak with Clarity & Confidence
pro_course_detail.description:
Want to speak English more clearly and naturally? As a linguist and pronunciation specialist, I help students correct pronunciation mistakes and gain confidence in their speech. My lessons are structured, supportive, and designed for real progress.  

What to Expect:  

- Focused Sound Training: You’ll read carefully chosen sentences. This allows me to identify pronunciation issues and help you correct all 50 American English sounds.  
 
- Custom Practice Materials: You’ll get word lists, spelling patterns, and tips to help you improve.  
 
- Practical Speaking Exercises: We’ll practice reading short articles aloud. This helps with pronunciation, fluency, and vocabulary growth.  
 
- Advanced Techniques: Learn how to stress words correctly, pronounce the schwa, relax your T, find your R, and handle -ed endings and final S sounds.  
 
- Step-by-Step Approach: Many students say they want a clear and systematic method—this course provides exactly that.  
 
- Optional Music-Based Practice: I’ve also created original songs with lyrics to help reinforce key sounds in a fun and natural way.  

I love teaching pronunciation and truly care about your progress. My lessons are structured but relaxed, detailed but enjoyable. You’ll feel supported every step of the way.  

Most students need about 10 class hours to practice and correct all 50 sounds. The best option is a 15-lesson package (45 minutes each). This allows time for refinement and conversation practice. Plus, ordering 15 lessons comes with a 10% discount.  

If you're ready to speak with more confidence, let’s get started!

pro_course_detail.title: Communicate with Confidence: Interview, Presentation & Exam Prep
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you need to prepare for an interview, give a presentation, or take the IELTS exam? This course is designed to help you communicate with clarity, confidence, and impact in high-stakes situations.

While I've only recently created this separate lesson category, during all of my time on Italki I've been supporting clients in:


I am ready to support you in:

- Preparing for job interviews – Frame your experience in a compelling way, refine your answers, and gain confidence in professional discussions.

- Improving your public speaking skills – Organize your thoughts, deliver clear and engaging presentations, and work on pacing, tone, and emphasis.

- Getting ready for the IELTS speaking exam – Practice common questions, structure strong responses, and boost your fluency and pronunciation.

I am an experienced interviewer, public speaker and interactive group conversation designer. I have a strong ability to listen, ask the right questions, and help you uncover the stories in your experience that are worth sharing. 

Whether you’re crafting answers for an interview, refining a speech, or structuring a presentation, I’ll help you identify your key strengths and express them effectively. In these lessons, I offer structured feedback, personalized coaching, and practical strategies to help you express yourself with professionalism and confidence.

For many package clients, I provide ongoing professional support for crafting important emails, brainstorming cross-cultural communication challenges, and other work-related communication tasks in English. A 10% discount is available on packages of 15 lessons.

Let’s work together to make sure you sound polished, professional, and ready to succeed!
